{07 19 00}I swear, {04 1f 00}, you've
got gift-giving skills{01 00 00 0a 00} like
no one I've ever met.
{07 00 00}And thanks to you,{01 00 00 05 00} my
wardrobe is just stuffed to
the gills now!
{07 0e 00}I think it's time for me to
stop hoarding clothes and
to start wearing them{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0b 00}So, what should I collect
next?{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Stay tuned for a
whole new me!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Ma vannun, {04 1f 00}, sul on
kinkimisoskused{01 00 00 0a 00} nagu
mitte kellelgi teisel.
{07 00 00}Ja tänu sulle{01 00 00 05 00} on mu
riidekapp nüüd
puupüsti täis!
{07 0e 00}Ma arvan, et on aeg
lõpetada riiete kogumine ja
hakata neid kandma{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0b 00}Mida ma peaksin järgmisena
koguma?{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Püsi lainel, tuleb
täiesti uus mina!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I've never met anyone{01 00 00 05 00} as
friendly and giving as you. 

{07 00 00}Thanks to you, {01 00 00 05 00}I've become
something of a 
fashionista, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 1b 00}But {01 00 00 0a 00}I think my days as a 
fashion icon are just about
over.
{07 19 00}I'd like to take this
opportunity to recognize
your passion{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}
{07 1a 00}Thank you, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
You're just a remarkable
person!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma pole kunagi kohanud
kedagi{01 00 00 05 00} nii sõbralikku ja

{07 00 00}Tänu sulle {01 00 00 05 00}olen ma saanud
omamoodi
moehulluks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 1b 00}Aga {01 00 00 0a 00}ma arvan, et mu päevad

{07 19 00}Tahaksin kasutada seda
võimalust, et tunnustada
sinu kirge{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 00 00}
{07 1a 00}Aitäh sulle, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
Sa oled tähelepanuväärne
inimene!
